rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use, and vendors may not sell or provide, a coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels using nonpublic competitor data. The City Attorney or an aggrieved tenant can sue; civil penalty up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.key_value: ban on coordinated pricing algorithms using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential dwelling units in Berkeley
rules.exemptions: Aggregated anonymous reports, affordable-housing limit tools, market research, appraisal, software research and training
rules.quoted_span: B. It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described
rules.interaction: No state-level ban in the corpus; local ban stands alone.

notes: Ordinance 7,992-N.S. text gives no effective date (it shows only the Nov 18, 2025 passage to print), so effective_date is null; status in_force assumes the ordinance took effect before 2026-10-01 (the brief cites 2026-03-01 per text vs January 2026 per a law-firm alert, neither visible in this doc).
